ex.s: Every day I feel myself maturing, I feel liberation drawing near, I feel the beauty of nature and the goodness of the people around me.
ex.t: 每一天我都感觉到自己在成熟，感觉到解放正在临近，感觉到自然之美和周围人们的善意。

ex.s: Lei Feng (1940-1962), a soldier in the Chinese People's Liberation Army who was honoured as a role model and dedicated worker on many occasions.
ex.t: 雷锋（1940-1962），中国人民解放军战士，多次被表彰为模范和敬业工作者。

ex.s: Prusiner Lei Feng (1940-1962), a soldier in the Chinese People's Liberation Army who was honoured as Ludwig Wittgenstein (1889-1951), an Austrian-born British philosopher and logician.
ex.t: 普鲁辛纳。雷锋（1940-1962），中国人民解放军战士，被尊为路德维希·维特根斯坦（1889-1951），奥地利出生的英国哲学家和逻辑学家。

ex.s: Monet and Renoir, along with other like-minded artists, sought liberation from the rules of the old style.
ex.t: 莫奈和雷诺阿，以及其他志同道合的艺术家，寻求从旧风格的规则中解放出来。
